state.task: Decompose five proven RAG pipeline structural defects into local ready-for-agent repair specifications, without implementing business code. User confirmed test seams: existing shared Answer entry, actual Chat HTTP SSE/JSON transports, frontend public response behavior, captured generation prompts, with real in-memory SQLite/Searcher boundary for PageIndex and controlled external model/services.
constraints: Retain architecture and existing permissions/active-version gates.
Every task independently shippable with complete behavior and tests.
Do not split backend fix and frontend status display of rejected drafts into separately shippable halves.
Use only genuine technical dependencies; priority order is separate.
No production corpus, key values or user docs supplied.
Current task specifies repairs only; live quality benchmark, graph capability buildout and Router redesign remain deferred.

provenDefects.behavior: Critic rejects hallucinated refund draft; runner tokens=[] but done.reply contains it. JSON returns terminal reply and frontend HTTP-ok displays complete. Shared entry, runners, HTTP and frontend all must honor terminal/public text contract.

Production complex tool-loop environment drops bound attachment session and web opt-in. Simple gets evidence and completes; complex does zero source calls and insufficient_retrieval for same scope/input.

New gap result appended after initial top-10 parent groups. Real default 6000-token assembler omits new fact in both prompts. Candidate trace includes new id. Selecting new gap candidates first is a deterministic standalone repair.

Evidence 600-char preview substitutes for complete content in compression and budget, while assembler uses parent windows. Raw parent material=30000 tokens; preview budget=3854; compression skipped; tail facts absent from its input. Common authorized fragment plan and measured actual output can be provided by repaired existing assembler/compressor.
PageIndex whole-table LIMIT 5 precedes KB/ACL filters. Adding 5 other-KB nodes makes target hits 1->0 with target stored. Eligibility must precede LIMIT; keep ES hydration rechecks.

state.metricContext: Current six retrieval metrics intentionally score final-round ordered pre-assembler candidates, preserving first passage rank, keeping unmappable candidates nonrelevant, GT misses=0, empty GT=null, honest rerank source. These metrics are valid as candidate-retrieval measures, but finalContext naming cannot prove content seen by generation. We need actual post-window/post-compression consumed ids/spans, and separate generator-context recall with explicit stage/version. Candidate recall and generated answer citations are neither substitute for consumed context. An id-only retained list cannot prove every claim survived semantic compression.

alternatives.five_per_defect: Five vertical fixes, combining deterministic correction selection and actual-context/evaluation trace under F3; F4 repairs common content representation. F3 becomes a larger runner+assembler+metric+transport integration change.
alternatives.six_behavior_seams: Six vertical specs: publish boundary; complex source propagation; correction selection under current assembler budget; complete authorized context/budget/compression representation including actual-output selection result; consumed-context trace and separate context recall while preserving candidate metrics; scoped PageIndex eligibility. Trace task has a genuine prerequisite on repaired actual-output result, correction selection can independently ship earlier. No standalone research/test tickets.
alternatives.seven_layer_tickets: Split publication backend and frontend; separate schema groundwork from consumers; seven or more tickets whose partial delivery may not protect the behavior.

granularity.instructions: Which decomposition best provides concrete independently accepted repair outcomes with minimal coordination for this existing codebase? Consider the actual contracts and alternatives in state, not an arbitrary target count.

criteria.five_per_defect: Five fixes; accept the wider F3 task to minimize spec count.
criteria.six_behavior_seams: Six fixes; separate selection effectiveness from honest observed consumption because their behavior, evidence and downstream metric consumers are independently testable.
criteria.seven_layer_tickets: Prefer seven or more layer-specific tickets even if they require all layers to fix one outcome.
criteria.insufficient_evidence: The alternatives cannot be evaluated from the available evidence.

metric_policy.instructions: Which metric policy best repairs the candidate-versus-consumed-context mismatch while preserving meaningful existing metrics?

criteria.preserve_candidate_add_consumed: Preserve six existing candidate ranking metrics with explicit stage labeling; add a separate actual generation-context recall/consumption trace and version/availability. Do not infer content truth from citation ids.
criteria.replace_candidate_with_consumed: Replace existing six metrics' input with post-budget consumed context and mark new version; drop the old candidate ranking metric meaning.
criteria.labels_only: Keep candidate metrics and change names only, without adding any actual consumption observation.
criteria.insufficient_evidence: No metric semantics can be settled.

correction_strategy.instructions: Which minimal first correction-selection repair is warranted for proven budget starvation while respecting current budgets?

criteria.deterministic_gap_first: For correction rounds, prioritize newly retrieved gap evidence deterministically before old context, deduplicate by stable document/chunk, reuse current parent grouping/budgets, record omitted evidence. No new model/rerank service.
criteria.global_llm_rerank: Add a new mandatory LLM global rerank for accumulated correction results.
criteria.raise_budget: Increase default context budget instead of changing ordering.
